issues.title: setup_script_path is validated, stored and tested — but never read; only a root setup.sh ever runs
issues.cleanup: Only owned fixture frontends stopped; copied fault-injected build removed; inert automations deactivated; bounded worker exited; normal launcher restored and doctored before stop.
issues.reason: Uploaded owned tarball scripts/setup.sh writes .qa-setup-marker, main.py requires marker; persisted setup_script_path scripts/setup.sh. UI Run now genuine BashOutput exits1 with QA_NESTED_SETUP_WAS_SKIPPED, proving nested setup ignored.
steps: Use a fresh owned run at the recorded frozen revision; doctor and complete onboarding before the UI drive.

- **Custom nested setup (`F23.script-section`, `F23.run-logs-modal`; creation in F22).** Arrange a reviewed tarball containing `scripts/setup.sh` that writes `.qa-setup-marker` and `main.py` that asserts that marker exists. Upload with `api POST /api/automation/v1/uploads?name=qa-nested-setup --write --data-file <tarball> --content-type application/gzip`; create with `entrypoint: python3 main.py`, `setup_script_path: scripts/setup.sh`, active state and yearly cron. Open the detail page and click **Run now**; correlate its `bash_command_id` with `api GET '/api/bash/bash_events/search?command_id__eq=<id>&limit=100'`. Expected: the configured nested setup runs before the entrypoint. Known failure, reproduced 2026-10-12 against automation 1.19.3: the real BashOutput exits 1 with the marker assertion, proving the setup step was skipped ([OpenHands/automation#343](https://github.com/OpenHands/automation/issues/343)). Only an owned marker is written; no external service or model is used.
